heroSub: I-FiveStar AI yakha ama-iOS utilities namathuluzi okusebenza. Siletha lokho abantu abakudingayo—ngokushesha nangokuthembeka.
aboutLead: Sinciphisa ubunzima futhi sikhitha izici ezibalulekile. Sixazulula izinkinga zangempela emisebenzini yama-document, okuqukethwe, nemigudu yokusebenza ephumelelayo.
missionBody: Hlohlisa kusasele isikhathi. Yakha okubalulekile kuqala, uthuthukise ngemibono.
principlesBody: UX eqondakalayo, ukusebenza okusheshayo, idatha encane.
focusBody: i-OCR, ukuphathwa kwe-PDF, ukudlala kwama-media, amathuluzi okuzenzakalela.
p1: Indlela yokusebenza ye-OCR yezincwadi eziskeniwe: khipha, sesha, fushane, i-TTS—igxile ekufihlekeni kwemininingwane ngokucutshungulwa kwendawo.
p2: Umdlali wevidiyo wendawo osheshayo nobulula. Akukho izikhangiso. Ukuhlanganiswa okujulile ne-iOS.
p4: Isofthware ehambisana ne-AI yendawo ukuze ivumele ukucutshungulwa okuhlukanisiwe nezingxoxo ezimfihlakele.
p5: Yenza izithombe-skrini ze-App Store kube lula ukuzihumusha nokuzenza zihambisane nezilimi ezahlukene ukuze zithunyelwe.
p6: Ingxoxo eseduze ngokuvuma nge-Bluetooth enohumusho lwe-AI olusekhaya okukhethwayo. Alikho i-akhawunti, alikho iserba yengxoxo ephakathi.
p7: Umphathi wemapasi olazi indawo. Iveza i-coupon efanele noma ikhadi lokuba yilungu ngesikhathi ufika.
p3: Amathuluzi angaphakathi emikhiqizo ye-App Store. Usekela ku-Swift/SwiftUI.
servicesLead: Incazelo ecacile yenkinga iyisheshisa ukukhishwa kwemikhiqizo.
contactLead: Kopisha ithempli elingezansi ukuze uthole izimpendulo ezisheshayo.
